criteria.long_description: The ZIP has index.html at its root, required files use local relative paths, the documented launch method works in a current desktop browser, and source and dependencies are inspectable.

ratings.description: Strong: the integrated package launches and operates as documented without a material technical failure
Partial: the package is substantially inspectable but a limited launch, path, dependency, or integration problem interferes
Not demonstrated: no assessable browser package or a core technical failure prevents play

criteria.long_description: A repeatable player action affects at least two stateful entities, resources, or environmental processes whose interactions shape subsequent play.

ratings.description: Strong: a coherent player loop and interacting ecosystem are clearly implemented
Partial: a playable action or interaction exists, but the loop or ecosystem is thin, disconnected, or inconsistently implemented
Not demonstrated: no assessable player loop or interacting procedural ecosystem

criteria.long_description: Outcomes arise from interacting rules and conditions, relevant state changes are legible, and a seed, initial state, configuration, or action sequence reproduces at least one reported outcome.

ratings.description: Strong: rule interaction produces legible variation and the reported evidence is reproducible
Partial: feedback or variation is present, but emergence, legibility, or reproduction evidence is incomplete
Not demonstrated: outcomes are absent, purely scripted, illegible, or unsupported by reproducible evidence

criteria.long_description: Instructions, controls, text, contrast, and alternatives for essential colour-, sound-, or animation-only information support use, and the video demonstrates representative play and system feedback.

ratings.description: Strong: a new player can operate and interpret the game, and the video clearly evidences representative play
Partial: the game remains usable but a limited instruction, control, access, or video-evidence problem interferes
Not demonstrated: use or interpretation is substantially blocked, or gameplay evidence is absent

criteria.long_description: The README documents launch, controls, goal, ecology, browser, and limitations; an external test separates observations from interpretations and supports a revision or retention decision; third-party work is accurately credited and licensed.

ratings.description: Strong: documentation, external evidence, revision reasoning, credits, and licences are complete and connected to the artifact
Partial: the record supports assessment but one material element is thin or incomplete
Not demonstrated: no assessable test-and-revision record or serious documentation/licensing gaps remain

criteria.description: Individual contribution, analysis, and applicable AI appendix
criteria.long_description: Each student identifies concrete contributions and analyzes one effect on the integrated system. When AI contributed to submitted work, complete relevant chatlogs are included without credentials or private third-party information.

ratings.description: Strong: every contribution entry is specific and analytical, and any applicable appendix is complete
Partial: entries or analysis are uneven, or an applicable appendix has a limited omission
Not demonstrated: contribution evidence or analysis is absent, or an applicable appendix has a material omission
